steps.en: The review screen offers a Confirm button to submit the court application
steps.id: Layar review punya tombol Confirm untuk submit court application
steps.why_en: No review screen or Confirm button exists.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada layar review atau tombol Confirm.

steps.en: Confirm triggers processing of the selected batch
steps.id: Confirm memicu pemrosesan batch yang dipilih
steps.why_en: Nothing exists to process a confirmed court batch.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada proses untuk batch pengadilan yang dikonfirmasi.

steps.en: OCMS sends the batch of notices to State Courts
steps.id: OCMS mengirim batch notice ke State Courts
steps.why_en: Nothing in the system sends a batch to the State Courts.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada yang mengirim batch ke State Courts di sistem.
